messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Changing button color
parts:
You can easily style the buttons by passing it the appropriate bootstrap class. Here is an example.
 
tags$button(class = 'btn btn-info')

You can find a full list of btn classes and the associated colors here http://twitter.github.io/bootstrap/base-css.html#buttons.

Hope this helps.
